note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). Event A is a generic fictional event and the consequences are generic fictional objects; no person is drawn and nobody is injured. The two rings are ONLY the supplied grouping: the inner ring holds the consequences supplied as 'Immediate consequence (as supplied)', the outer ring those supplied as 'Subsequent consequence (as supplied) — to be examined', with identical stroke, colour and weight; neither is shown as excluded, lesser or decided. No remoteness or scope doctrine, test, liability, amount, outcome or jurisdiction is stated. The contrasted fact is ONE supplied grouping: the focus consequence (focusItem) is grouped in the inner ring in A and in the outer ring in B; its own 'ring' value is not used. Omitted brief fields (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, 2026-10-05): none — events, causalLinks, alternatives and losses are editable, with the contrast fields (scenarioA, scenarioB, changedFact, sharedFacts, comparisonLabels); 'origin' and 'focusItem' are added. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692; subject floor 'Subject ≥ 0.20 of the frame height at rest and hold' (causation-05 LAW-0700 decision, production/SESSION_HANDOFF.md)). True driver: the 1:1 box — each field (plate, objects, markers, floor) must reach 0.20 of the frame height with each lane >= 0.40 of the frame width while the stress text stays >= 16 px. Fallbacks tried: row, column and a right-hand text column (textcol, with the late chips under the lanes), head chips beside the fields, the guide chip beside, above or in the shared band (with a leader), half-width band chips, text down to 17 px. Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-10-05; pre-cap copy in production/scratch/causation-08/LAW-0711.stress-precap.json): full counts (six consequences, two accounts, one labelled link, two grouping items) → 1:1 fallback scale k 0.714, field 0.101 of the frame height; four consequences → 0.193; four consequences and one account → 0.193; five consequences, one account, one grouping item → 0.193; four consequences, one account, one grouping item → 1:1 0.249 (9:16 0.214). The stress therefore caps the COUNTS at four consequences (the first four), one account put forward (the first) and one grouping item (the first) — baseline 3 / 0 / 1; the labelled link is kept; every text field keeps its near-maximum length and stays strictly longer than the baseline.
